products.title: Knitted in Denmark Caro scarf, Stripe Red/White
products.body_html:
Caro Editions takes inspiration from the classic triangular scarf by Nørgaard paa Strøget. Appliquéd hearts and pink details give the scarf a playful, nostalgic feel that reflects the signature aesthetic of Caro Editions.

The scarf is part of our anniversary collection, celebrating 40 years of Mads Nørgaard – Copenhagen. The collection features four scarves, including three created in collaboration with Farshad Farzankia, Henrik Vibskov and Caro Editions, each bringing their own interpretation of the iconic Nørgaard stripe.

products.title: 100% Cashmere Premium Ellen Scarf, Black / White
products.body_html:
Premium Ellen pays tribute to Mads’ mother, Ellen, and the Nørgaard family’s original stripes: the long-sleeved #101 T-shirt in black and white with a red neckline. Now, the original stripe returns as a scarf in 100% cashmere.

The scarf is part of our anniversary collection, celebrating 40 years of Mads Nørgaard – Copenhagen. The collection features four scarves, including three created in collaboration with Farshad Farzankia, Henrik Vibskov and Caro Editions, each bringing their own interpretation of the iconic Nørgaard stripe.

products.title: 100% Silk Farshad Scarf, Red Multi
products.body_html:
Farshad Farzankia’s artwork Eddy i himlen has made its way from the gallery wall onto this silk scarf. The artwork comes to life in vibrant colours, framed by red and white stripes that give the design a graphic feel.
The scarf is part of Mads Nørgaard – Copenhagen’s 40th anniversary collection, featuring collaborations with Farshad Farzankia, Henrik Vibskov and Caro Editions, each bringing their own interpretation of the iconic Nørgaard stripe.

products.title: Woven Wool Vibskov Scarf, Brown
products.body_html:
Henrik Vibskov brings his unconventional approach to the iconic Nørgaard stripes, reworking them diagonally in this scarf made from 100% wool. Four coloured threads in black, white, brown and green are woven together, creating a pattern that appears as its own negative on the reverse.

The scarf is part of our anniversary collection, celebrating 40 years of Mads Nørgaard – Copenhagen. The collection features four scarves, including three created in collaboration with Farshad Farzankia, Henrik Vibskov and Caro Editions, each offering their own interpretation of the iconic Nørgaard stripe.
